sloka: ददृशुः वानराः शुभ्रान् जातरूपस्य संचयान् ।तत्र तत्र विचिन्वन्तो बिले तत्र महा प्रभाः ॥४-५०-३८॥
transliteration: dadṛśuḥ vānarāḥ śubhrān jātarūpasya saṁcayān ।tatra tatra vicinvanto bile tatra mahā prabhāḥ ॥4-50-38॥

translations.english: While searching here and there in the cave, the strong and powerful monkeys discovered a woman not far from there.
